Destructive pattern detected: rm -rf
Full command: rm -rf /tmp/x
This command is permanently blocked. Safe route: for a single file, use 'unlink <file>' instead of rm -rf. For a directory or multiple files, move the target into a temp dir (e.g. 'mkdir -p /tmp/trash && mv <target> /tmp/trash/') instead of deleting it outright.
